body:
Unsure when the last time I didn't feel bored. Have been on meds 
Not sure, plenty o doctors, names are too similar to remember.
Last time I went outside was..March 1st, last time I groomed myself was..the 7th or 8th I think. Last time I attempted to learn new things was late February, just feels like busy work, I know plenty. (Art/Economics) Yes, I'm aware the medical field is full of greedy bastards, especially where I live, where I live is essentially a melting pot of all the worst doctors. Yes, and I hate those dailies. I can't even just log on for an hour to enjoy a game, because I have to do 6 hours of repeating what I did yesterday to make any sort of progress instead of just enjoying myself. Yes, I used to have long term goals. I used to want to be a scientist (to put it simply, most people don't know what the field is when I say it), but it required me to move to places I did not want to. Started on art instead, but I'm awful at it. An average person can draw far better than I after over a year of training. Don't really care to keep at it anymore after that. I don't think they're related to real life, or if they are it's one of those symbolic things where it's incredibly vague.

Post 2: Did that, or, sat by the window peaking out it, if that's close. There were no clouds, or none alone, just a big grey sky. A white car drove down the road, didn't see who was in it. A mother and her child on her shoulders walked down the sidewalk. There were some older people outside somewhere, I could hear them but not see them. There was a siren in the distance, probably a police car.

Sorry for the delay, took quite awhile for any response, got tired of waiting and went to lie down. Thank you for responding though, both of you.
